# Next.js Project with React, TypeScript, ESLint, React Query, and TailwindCSS

This is a side project POC using modern React development tools and libraries.

## Project Stack

- Next.js 15+ (React framework with App Router)
- TypeScript (type safety)
- ESLint (code linting)
- Prettier (code formatting)
- TailwindCSS (utility-first CSS)
- React Query (@tanstack/react-query) (data fetching)
- Zustand (state management)
- React Hook Form (form handling)
- Zod (schema validation)

## Development Guidelines

- Use TypeScript for all components and utilities
- Follow React best practices and hooks patterns
- Use TailwindCSS classes for styling
- Implement React Query for all API calls and data management
- Follow ESLint rules for code consistency
- Use Prettier for automatic code formatting (run `npm run format`)
- Use the App Router for all new pages and layouts
- Keep components small and focused on single responsibilities
